elements.name: White Wombat 51
elements.author: mRcOol7
elements.description: Gradient 3d pill green text input that glows and scales up on hover.
elements.howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes 0 2px 5px #000000, 0 0 10px #000000 inset, background changes from linear-gradient(
    to bottom right,
    #ffffff,
    transparent
  ) to linear-gradient(to right, #e6e6e6, #f9f9f9), border-color becomes #999. On focus, border-color becomes #4caf50, background changes from linear-gradient(
    to bottom right,
    #ffffff,
    transparent
  ) to linear-gradient(to right, #c2f0c2, #f0f0f0), transform becomes rotateX(20deg).

On focus, background changes from #fff to #f0f0f0, transform becomes translateZ(20px) translateX(-5px) translateY(-5px), box-shadow becomes 5px 5px 0 0 #000.
